content.description: Raw content to extract VoC from (forum thread body, review text, transcript, etc.). Either this or `pages` (ADR 1116).

pages.description: The `pages` output of `core.web.fetch` (ADR 1116 D2). One AI call per readable page (2xx, no error, non-empty extractedText), up to maxPages; each record is stamped with its page. Every page body and title reaches the model inside the untrusted-content fence.

maxPages.description: Pages lane: how many readable pages to extract from, one AI call each. Default 3, cap 5; a numeric string counts.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the content source (for traceability + cited in summary).

sourceTitle.description: Title of the content (thread title, article title, etc.).

platform.description: Source platform tag (reddit / quora / g2 / capterra / forum / blog / etc.).

community.description: Community / subreddit / forum identifier within the platform.

icpContext.description: An object, or the same object as a JSON string (ADR 1116 D3).

productContext.description: An object, or the same object as a JSON string (ADR 1116 D3).

maxRecords.description: Upper bound on records the AI is asked to return. Defaults to 15.
